review_candidates.title: Head of Legal – GRC | Consumer Law | Technology & AI Uplift
review_candidates.description: The opportunity Our client is a substantial Australian-owned business selling consumer and commercial goods at scale, primarily through online channels, and trading nationally across every state and territory. The business is investing heavily in technology and is applying that same thinking to how its legal, governance, risk and compliance function should operate. Selling online at volume, direct to consumers and commercial buyers, produces a genuinely broad Australian Consumer Law and regulatory risk profile. The remit is to build the legal, governance, risk and compliance function with the efficiency and technology-first thinking the rest of the business is applying. The role This is not a conventional head of legal brief. You will own the legal function and the group's governance, regulatory and compliance risk posture – and you will be expected to redesign how that work is delivered, not simply do more of it. Own the legal, governance, risk and compliance technology stack – selecting, implementing and driving genuine adoption across the function Automate contract generation, amendment and execution, and put in place registers, workflow and reporting that maintain themselves Deploy AI where it earns its place – first pass drafting and review, continuous regulatory monitoring, and triage of routine matters – with human accountability retained where outcomes affect customers Build fit-for-purpose governance, risk and compliance frameworks sized to the business as it is now, not to a best-practice template Own Australian Consumer Law compliance end to end – online advertising and product descriptions, consumer guarantees, misleading and deceptive conduct, and unfair contract terms across all sales channels Own privacy and data obligations across a very large online customer database, working with the technology and marketing functions on data handling and personalisation Manage regulator matters as they arise, with a fast, commercial and proportionate response Act as Privacy Officer and as the accountable officer for the group's Whistleblower Policy Lead and develop a small, capable team including an experienced Legal and Compliance Manager About you You are a qualified lawyer, comfortable operating across a broad remit of legal, governance, risk and compliance. You give commercially pragmatic advice – a clear recommendation in plain language – and you have designed frameworks sized to the organisation you were in. Critically, you have genuinely selected, implemented or governed technology inside a legal, governance or compliance function. Not simply used AI tools personally – actually built the workflow, the guardrails and the escalation logic around them, and got an organisation to adopt them. Australian Consumer Law experience is strongly preferred – consumer guarantees, misleading and deceptive conduct and unfair contract terms in a consumer-facing business. Experience in an online, retail or digital sales environment will be well regarded. Why it is worth a conversation A broad remit across legal, governance, risk and compliance in a genuinely commercial, fast-moving business, with the mandate and the backing to build the function around efficiencies. You will work closely with the Executive Leadership Team and report to the Managing Director of the group. Where the role sits in the leadership structure will be shaped by the person appointed. Contact Greenfields Executive Recruitment & Search has been retained on an exclusive basis for this appointment. All applications and enquiries are managed directly by Greenfields. Please send your resume in confidence to Catherine Wolfe-Coote, Managing Director, Greenfields Executive Recruitment & Search. Email catherinew@greenfieldssearch.com.au About Greenfields Executive Recruitment & Search Greenfields is one of Sydney's most highly valued, top ranked executive search firms in legal, governance, risk, compliance and company secretarial appointments. We are led by Catherine Wolfe-Coote, Owner, Founder and Managing Director, and are frequently retained by ASX-listed companies, private and family-owned groups, not-for-profits and government to appoint Chief Legal Officers, General Counsel, General Counsel & Company Secretary, Heads of Legal, Heads of Legal, Governance, Risk and Compliance, Head of Governance and Company Secretary, Heads of Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), and highly technical senior in-house counsel. We have particular expertise in appointments where legal and governance capability intersects with technology and AI – the emerging profile of the modern in-house legal function.

review_candidates.description: We are a well-established international company in the high-value/investment retail sector, and we are entering an ambitious new phase of growth. Hong Kong is a cornerstone of that plan, and we are in the process of opening our first retail location in the city. Working closely with our regional leadership team, you will be our key person on the ground in Hong Kong, helping to launch, operate and grow our business in one of Asia’s most important retail markets. What we build here will set the blueprint for future expansion across the region. We are starting fresh, with no existing store or local team. You will help take the business from a blank page to opening day and beyond: securing and fitting out the site, hiring and developing the team, putting processes in place, and then running day-to-day operations. This is a very hands-on role, and you will be as comfortable on the shop floor as you are meeting landlords, banks or senior management. It is challenging, fast-paced and highly visible. You will report to senior leadership and have real autonomy and ownership. For a builder who thrives on responsibility, this is a rare chance to create something from the ground up and leave a lasting mark. Key Responsibilities Drive the on-the-ground setup of our Hong Kong retail location, working with our regional team on site selection, fit-out, security arrangements, vendor and contractor coordination, and opening preparations. Build an effective local team: hire, train, motivate and lead staff, and create a strong culture of performance, service and integrity. Contribute to and execute local business plans, sales strategies and revenue targets Run day-to-day store operations, including inventory management, cash and stock controls, and secure storage and security procedures. Ensure the Hong Kong operation meets all local regulatory and licensing requirements, including AML/CTF and KYC obligations, working with our group compliance team. Build and maintain relationships with clients, suppliers, landlords, banks, logistics and security partners. Monitor market trends and competitor activity in Hong Kong’s high-value retail market. Prepare regular performance, financial and operational reports for management Requirements Hong Kong Permanent Resident or eligible to work in Hong Kong without sponsorship. 8+ years’ experience in luxury, jewellery, gold bullion or other high-value retail, including at least 5 years in a managerial or leadership role. Hands-on experience opening at least one retail location from scratch, covering site selection, fit-out, staffing and launch; experience with multiple openings is a strong advantage. Strong knowledge of Hong Kong’s retail landscape and key shopping districts. Experience managing high-value inventory, including stock control, cash handling and security procedures. Familiarity with Hong Kong’s regulatory landscape, particularly AML/CTF and KYC requirements. Excellent people management skills, with a track record of hiring, training and leading retail teams. Entrepreneurial and hands-on: you take initiative, solve problems on the spot and enjoy building something new. An established network in Hong Kong’s luxury or high-value retail sector is a strong plus. Fluent in Cantonese and English; proficiency in Mandarin is an advantage. What We Offer Very competitive remuneration package with performance-based incentives. The opportunity to help build a new business from day one. Real ownership and visibility within an international organization. Long-term career growth as our Hong Kong presence expands. Backing of an established and reputable international company. All applications will be treated in strict confidence. The company name will be shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage. We will only contact candidates who are shortlisted.
